message: Elevated fasting glucose together with elevated liver enzymes (ALT/AST) can co-occur with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), which is commonly associated with insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes risk.
Elevated fasting glucose combined with elevated HbA1c suggests sustained high blood sugar levels, consistent with a diabetes or pre-diabetes pattern.

condition: high('ldl') and (high('total_cholesterol') or high('triglycerides')) and low('hdl')
message: High LDL and triglycerides alongside low HDL indicate a dyslipidemia pattern, a recognized risk factor for cardiovascular disease.
Elevated creatinine and urea together suggest reduced kidney filtration efficiency and may warrant renal function follow-up.
Elevated TSH with low hemoglobin can co-occur, as hypothyroidism is a recognized contributor to anemia.
Elevated white blood cell count with low platelet count can be seen in certain infections and warrants clinical correlation.
